question: Do you have a large family?
answer: Yes, I have a big family, but we don’t all live together. My grandparents live in the countryside, and my uncles and aunts live in different cities. We usually meet during holidays or family parties. It’s always nice to see everyone again, share stories, and eat delicious food together. I think having a big family is great because there’s always love and support around.

question: Tell me about the place you live at
answer: I live in Hanoi, the capital city of Vietnam. It’s a busy and modern city, but there are also many peaceful places like lakes and parks. I live alone in an apartment, and everything is quite convenient — shops, schools, and restaurants are nearby. I like living here because I’m working here and I want my future family to live here too.

question: What’s your favorite season? Why?
answer: My favorite season is autumn. The weather is cool and comfortable, not too hot or too cold. In Hanoi, the air feels fresh and the trees turn yellow, which looks really beautiful. I also love drinking coffee and walking outside during this time. It makes me feel relaxed and happy.

question: What’s the weather like today?
answer: Today, the weather is quite nice. It’s sunny but not too hot, and there’s a little wind. The sky looks clear and blue, so it’s a good day to go out for a walk or meet friends. I think this kind of weather makes everyone feel more active and cheerful.

question: How do you relax in the evening?
answer: In the evening, I usually relax by watching movies or listening to music. Sometimes I cook something simple for dinner and enjoy it while watching YouTube. When I feel tired after work, I just take a shower and go for a short walk outside. It helps me feel calm and ready for the next day.

question: What’s your favorite music?
answer: My favorite type of music is pop. I like listening to singers like Ed Sheeran or Taylor Swift because their songs are relaxing and easy to sing along with. I often play music when I’m working or cleaning my room. It makes me feel energetic and in a good mood.

question: Describe a member of your family
answer: I’d like to talk about my mother. She’s a kind and hardworking woman. She always takes care of our family and makes sure everyone is happy. My mom is also a great cook — I really love her food. In her free time, she likes watching TV or chatting with my father. I admire her a lot because she always supports me and teaches me to be a good person.

question: Describe the room you are in
answer: I’m sitting in my bedroom right now. It’s not very big, but it’s comfortable. There’s a bed, a desk, and a small bookshelf. I usually study or watch movies here. The walls are light blue, and there’s a window that lets in a lot of sunlight. I really like this room because it’s quiet and it feels like my own space.

question: Please tell me about your job
answer: I’m working as a software engineer. I design and build applications for different projects. I really enjoy solving problems and creating something useful. Sometimes the job can be stressful, but I like learning new things and working with my team. It’s a great way to grow and improve my skills.

question: What do you like doing in your free time
answer: In my free time, I like watching movies, listening to music, and reading books. Sometimes I go out with my friends for coffee or take a walk to relax. I think spending free time doing what I love helps me feel more balanced and happy.

question: Please tell me about your best friend
answer: My best friend’s name is Nam. We’ve known each other since high school. He’s a funny and honest person, and we can talk about everything. We often hang out, play games, or just chat online. I really value our friendship because he always supports me when I need help.

question: Please tell me about the last thing you saw on television
answer: The last thing I watched on TV was a travel show about Japan. It showed beautiful places and delicious food. I really enjoyed it because I love learning about different cultures. It also made me want to visit Japan someday.

question: Please describe your typical day
answer: On a normal day, I wake up around 6:30 and have breakfast. Then I go to work and spend most of the day at the office. After work, I usually exercise or watch something to relax. Before going to bed, I like reading or listening to music. It’s a simple but good routine.

question: What sports do people like in your country
answer: In Vietnam, people like many sports, but football is the most popular. You can see people playing football everywhere — in parks, schools, and even small streets. Besides that, some people enjoy badminton, swimming, or running to stay healthy.

question: Please tell me about your favorite film
answer: My favorite film is The Pursuit of Happyness. It’s about a man who works hard to achieve his dreams despite many challenges. The story is very touching and inspiring. Every time I watch it, I feel motivated to never give up.

question: Please tell me the best way to travel around your country
answer: I think the best way to travel around Vietnam is by motorbike. It’s cheap, fast, and you can see a lot of beautiful scenery on the way. For long trips, I prefer taking a train because it’s comfortable and safe.

question: Please describe your journey here today
answer: My journey today was quite simple. I left home around 8 o’clock and came straight here. The traffic was not too bad, and the weather was nice. It took me about 20 minutes, so it was a smooth trip.

question: Please tell me about a famous place in your country
answer: One famous place in Vietnam is Ha Long Bay. It’s known for its beautiful limestone islands and clear blue water. Many tourists visit there every year. I went there once and really enjoyed the boat trip and the amazing views.

question: What do you like doing with your friends
answer: I like going out for food or coffee with my friends. Sometimes we watch movies or play sports together. I always feel relaxed and happy when we meet, because we can laugh and share stories.

question: Please describe your house
answer: My house is a small but cozy place. It has two floors, with a living room, kitchen, and bedrooms upstairs. The living room is my favorite part because that’s where my family spends time together watching TV or talking after dinner.

question: Please tell me about yourself
answer: My name is Kevin. I’m from Hanoi, and I work as a software engineer. I’m a friendly and hardworking person who loves learning new things. In my free time, I enjoy reading, listening to music, and spending time with my family and friends.

question: Please tell me about your favorite book
answer: My favorite book is The Alchemist by Paulo Coelho. It’s about a young man who follows his dreams and learns important lessons about life. I like it because it inspires me to keep chasing my goals no matter how difficult things get.

question: What sport do you like
answer: I like playing badminton. It’s easy to play and doesn’t need too much equipment. I often play with my friends at the weekend. It’s good exercise and helps me stay healthy and active.

question: What did you do last night
answer: Last night, I stayed at home and watched a movie on Netflix. After that, I cooked a light dinner and spent some time reading. It was a relaxing evening, and I went to bed early because I had to get up early this morning.

question: Tell me about yourself and what you are looking for in your new house
answer: I’m working in Hanoi, and I’m looking for a new house that’s quiet and close to my workplace. I want a comfortable place with good light and maybe a small kitchen. I prefer a modern apartment where I can relax after work.

question: Please tell me why you are learning English
answer: I’m learning English because it’s very useful for my job and my future career. I often work with foreign clients, so English helps me communicate better. Also, I want to travel abroad and experience different cultures.

question: Tell me about your family
answer: There are four people in my family — my parents, my sister, and me. We are very close and often spend weekends together. My parents are kind and hardworking, and my sister is funny and talkative. I feel lucky to have them.

question: Please tell me why you are interested in travel
answer: I love traveling because it helps me relax and learn new things. When I visit new places, I can try local food, meet new people, and see beautiful views. It’s a great way to enjoy life and get more experiences.

question: Please tell me what you do at the weekend
answer: On weekends, I usually sleep a bit longer and then go out with my friends or family. Sometimes I stay home to clean my room or watch a movie. I like weekends because I can rest and prepare for the next week.

question: Where did you go last weekend
answer: Last weekend, I went to the countryside to visit my grandparents. The air there was fresh, and I helped them in the garden. It was peaceful and relaxing. I really enjoyed spending time with my family.
